meta.note: This repository (branch arena/c66d4db8-universal-anime, base commit 719bc6f) contained no characters.json when phase 0 was executed. The character database is the source of truth and was therefore NOT fabricated: no records were invented, no ids were reserved, no names were altered. Put the authoritative file at data/characters.json (or at data/characters.local.json, which is git-ignored and takes precedence) and reload the game. The loader accepts either a bare JSON array of records or an object with a 'characters' array.

expectedShape.name: string (canonical, never translated by the game)
expectedShape.powers: array of {name, description} or array of strings
expectedShape.status: optional, one of the status names in docs/CHARACTER_DATA_SPEC.md
